qs.q: A 4-month-old female infant presents with acute urinary retention and a cystic mass protruding at the urethral meatus. What is the most common underlying cause for this presentation?
qs.e: A ureterocele is a cystic dilation of the distal aspect of the ureter and is recognized as the commonest cause of urine retention in female infants. Other obstructions like posterior urethral valves are more typical in males.
